messages:
Nina: quick sync on cohort preemption gate signals before we finalize the API. want a concrete list of telemetry and abort rules.
Raj: concrete: kv_reuse_ratio, cohort_queue_p50/p95, p99_latency, and a headroom_estimate = kv_hits_prefetch / kv_prefetch_attempts.
Omar: add short-derivative signals: d(kv_reuse_ratio)/dt and d(queue_len)/dt to catch rapid thrash.
Clara: sampling constraint: don't export per-cohort series for all tenants. use top-k sketch + percentiles.
Nina: rollout guard: abort if canary p99 > baseline_p99 * 1.2 OR canary_cost_per_request > baseline_cost * 1.3 over 1h.
Raj: canary sizing: start 5% cohorts hashed by cohort_id. expand to 50% only after 48h stable.
Omar: preempt flow: stop new enqueues to cohort, migrate queued requests to microlane, leave inflight to finish. optional replicate-hedge for long inflight if p_breach > 0.6.
Clara: trace tags: routing.decision, cohort.id, preempted=true|false, replicate=true|false, kv_reuse_ratio, headroom_est. keep tags low-cardinality.
Nina: API: tenant flag preemptibility=[preemptible, non_preemptible]. non_preemptible returns PREEMPTION_FORBIDDEN when attempted.
Raj: tests: admission-sim job with synthetic hot-tenant (20x baseline) comparing epoch=500ms vs 2s. include token_cost model.
infra-bot: deploy queued: batcher-preempt-gates v0.2 -> staging at 2026-03-20T09:10Z :rocket:
Nina: ok team. Raj -> sim by Tue. Clara -> dashboard mock Wed. Omar -> hedging predictor hook. i'll update RFC with the guard thresholds and state machine.
